(async()=>{const c=window.__game.scene; const V=c.camera.position.constructor; const cv=document.getElementById('game'); const rc=cv.getBoundingClientRect();const fr=(n)=>new Promise(res=>{const f=()=>(--n<=0?res():requestAnimationFrame(f)); requestAnimationFrame(f);});const mv=(x,y)=>window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{clientX:rc.left+x, clientY:rc.top+y, bubbles:true}));const mvW=(w)=>{const p=c.toScreen(w); mv(p.x,p.y); return p;};const dn=(b=0)=>{const m=window.__game.input.mouse; cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{clientX:rc.left+m.x, clientY:rc.top+m.y, button:b, bubbles:true}));};const upp=(b=0)=>{const m=window.__game.input.mouse; window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{clientX:rc.left+m.x, clientY:rc.top+m.y, button:b, bubbles:true}));};const clk=async(b=0)=>{dn(b); await fr(2); upp(b);};const kd=(code)=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code, bubbles:true}));const ku=(code)=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code, bubbles:true}));const until=async(fn,ms=60000)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(!fn()){ if(performance.now()-t0>ms) return false; await fr(1);} return true;};if(!c.step) return 'no step'; try {const s=c.step; const ctr=s.center; let a=0; const R=s.r*0.6; let n=0; const shotAt=20;while(!s.done && a<6*6.283 && n<400){ a+=0.9; mvW(new V(ctr.x+Math.cos(a)*R, s.surfaceY, ctr.z+Math.sin(a)*R)); await fr(1); n++; if(n===shotAt) break; }return 'stir travel '+(s.travel/6.283).toFixed(2)+' spills '+s.spills;} catch(e) { return 'bot error: '+e.message; }})()
